---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect or unexpected behavior
labels: bug
---

## Summary

A concise description of the incorrect behavior.

## Reproduction

Steps to reproduce, with firmware profile (`gateway` or `appliance`) and app
platform (`iOS`, `Android`, or `web`) where relevant.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened instead.

## Observed diagnostics

USB Serial/JTAG logs, `node.diagnostics` output, or radio-trace excerpts. Do not
paste private message content or credentials.

## Environment

- Board and radio variant
- Firmware profile and format versions
- App version and OS version
